0022600004.text: Both the Timberwolves and the Miami Heat open their 2026-27 seasons, making this the first game of the season for Minnesota, which is at Miami. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out following Achilles surgery, and lists Anthony Edwards, Ayo Dosunmu, Bones Hyland, Enrique Freeman, Jaden McDaniels, Jonathan Kuminga, LaMelo Ball, Rocco Zikarsky, Rudy Gobert, and Trey Lyles as day-to-day, while Miami lists Bam Adebayo, Dru Smith, Ezra Ausar, Giannis Antetokounmpo, and Pelle Larsson as day-to-day. The Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 2-0 and last met the Heat on January 6, 2026, in Minneapolis, winning 122-94, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Minnesota a 50% chance to win.
